proc_onboarding.name: Employee Onboarding
proc_onboarding.riskRefs: Late IT provisioning, Missed compliance training

guardrail.allow: Send onboarding checklist reminders, auto-schedule orientation calendar invites
guardrail.deny: Approve compensation changes, modify offer terms
guardrail.escalateIf: New-hire start date changes within 5 business days

guardrail.allow: Create standard accounts from the approved role template
guardrail.deny: Grant admin or privileged system access

proc_complaint.name: Customer Complaint Resolution
proc_complaint.kpiRefs: Mean time to resolution, First-contact resolution rate
proc_complaint.riskRefs: Regulatory complaint mishandling, Repeat unresolved complaints

guardrail.allow: Log complaint, send acknowledgement, issue goodwill credit under $50
guardrail.deny: Issue refunds above policy limit, make legal admissions
guardrail.escalateIf: Severity is High, or customer requests a manager

proc_complaint.notes: Seeded example demonstrating an exclusive-gateway severity split.
